AAQ.caption: Template ID
AAQ.doc: Starts with 'tpl_' prefix, and can be obtained from your DocSpring account.
AAQ.name: templateId

AAR.caption: Data
AAR.doc: These are the variables which can be forwarded to DocSpring to be filled in your template. Example: Adding a text field into your template with the name 'firstName' and setting the value of 'firstName' in this action to 'John' will result in 'John' being added to your submission. Use '/' for nested fields and lists, such as 'address/city' or 'items/0/name'. Date fields take dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
AAR.name: data

AAS.caption: Enable Booleans
AAS.doc: If enabled, any fields with the exact value of "true" or "false" will be parsed as booleans (true and false) instead of as text.
AAS.name: parseAsBoolean

AAg.caption: Test Mode
AAg.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. Set Test Mode to no to remove the watermarks (and make sure you are using a live API token: test API tokens always generate test PDFs).
AAg.name: test

AAj.caption: Metadata
AAj.doc: Send some metadata for the PDF submission. Metadata cannot be used to fill out fields, but it will be sent with any webhooks, and you can see it in the web interface when you view a submission.
AAj.name: metadata

ALO.caption: Template Version
ALO.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
ALO.name: version

ALP.caption: Make Page Images
ALP.doc: Also make a PNG image of each page of the PDF (up to 100 pages).
ALP.name: makePageImages

ALQ.caption: PDF Password
ALQ.doc: Optional. A password that the PDF needs to be opened with. DocSpring never returns it.
ALQ.name: password

ALR.caption: Expires In (Seconds)
ALR.doc: Optional. Seconds after the PDF is generated until DocSpring deletes it and its data, up to 10 years (315360000). Default: the template's expiration setting.
ALR.name: expiresIn

ALS.caption: Field Overrides (JSON)
ALS.doc: Optional, advanced. Changes to field settings for this PDF only, as a JSON object by field name, such as {"name": {"required": false, "font_size": 9}}.
ALS.name: fieldOverrides

PENDING-EDITABLE.caption: Editable
PENDING-EDITABLE.doc: Optional. yes keeps the PDF's text and check box fields fillable, and no flattens every field. Blank: the template's setting.
PENDING-EDITABLE.name: editable
